idiom_name: typed sentinel union on a work channel
implementation_notes: TypeScript runs on the JavaScript runtime, so the mechanics are the same - a tagged stop message for userland queues or a stream close() - and the type system adds a compile-time contract: a discriminated union (type Msg = Job | { kind: 'stop' }) plus exhaustive switching forces every consumer to handle the pill. The runtime primitives come from the host platform (worker_threads postMessage, ReadableStreamDefaultController.close(), AbortSignal); because types are erased, the sentinel must still be a real tagged value, never a type-only marker.
pitfalls: Types are erased at runtime: a TS-only union member cannot act as the pill - the discriminator must exist as a real property on the message.
An as-cast or structurally similar object can masquerade as the stop message, because excess-property checks do not run at runtime; validate the tag at the channel boundary.
Awaiting work inside the consumer loop delays the pill behind slow jobs; pair the sentinel with an AbortSignal when shutdown must pre-empt in-flight work.
